verses.text: Remind God's people to accept the authority of rulers and leaders, to obey them, and to be ready to do every good thing.
Remind them not to speak evil of anyone, and not to start fights. They should be gentle and always humble towards everyone.
At one time we too were foolish and did not obey. We were fooled and were slaves to all kinds of desires and pleasures. We lived with spite and jealousy. People hated us, and we hated each other.
But then the kindness and love of God our Saviour for people appeared.
He saved us, not because of good things we had done, but because of his mercy. He saved us by washing us, so that we were born again and made new by the Holy Spirit.
God poured out the Spirit on us richly through Jesus Christ our Saviour.
He did this so that, made right with God by his grace, we would receive what he promised, with the hope of life that lasts for ever.
This is a saying you can trust. I want you to stress these things, so that those who believe in God will be careful to keep doing good. These things are good and helpful for everyone.
But keep away from foolish arguments, lists of ancestors, quarrels and fights about the law. They are useless and worth nothing.
Warn a person who causes divisions once, and then a second time. After that, have nothing more to do with him.
You can be sure that such a person has turned from the right way and is sinning. He judges himself by what he does.
When I send Artemas or Tychicus to you, do your best to come to me at Nicopolis, because I have decided to spend the winter there.
Do all you can to help Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their way. Make sure they have everything they need.
Our people must learn to keep doing good, to meet real needs. Then their lives will not be wasted.
Everyone who is with me greets you. Greet those who love us in the faith. Grace be with you all. Amen.
